name: air-compose Demo
postStartCommand: mkdir -p /data /data/repo && cd /data && nohup /app/air-compose run > /tmp/air-compose.log 2>&1 & sleep 5; echo '=== air-compose log ==='; cat /tmp/air-compose.log; echo '=== Port check ==='; curl -s http://localhost:5005 > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'Port 5005 is open ✅' || echo 'Port 5005 is NOT open ❌'
